about: Preset skies to load from Settings > Gameplay > Preset sky (the host's, for everyone in co-op). Each: key (kept in the settings), label (the menu's), group (the list's headings), note (the hint), and a weather like the sky bench's ({preset, cloud/low/mid/high in %, rain/snow mm per hour, visibility m, humidity %, cape J/kg, cloud_base m, wind m/s, road_wet/puddles 0..1, code WMO, ...}) or recorded (a day in Data/Sky/days). Optional showers_around (with shower_rain, mm/h): that many showers scattered round the rider up to 40 km off, so the clouds round about and the rain shafts under them can be seen. Optional moon (full, new or half): the night sky shows that moon (its clock moved up to a fortnight). Optional sun: the sun's height in degrees that the clock moves to today (with evening: true after noon); without it the clock stays as it is. Add or change skies here: the game reads this file again when it changes.
